title: ID0454085-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003320] timeSyncStatusIsOk: false
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: Outlet out of order due to Status flag #4 - timeSyncStatusIsOk.
Solution:
update from v6.0.3 to v7.0.5 version of firmware.
